source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: If you have the time and are willing to take on another project, I'd like us to create the cheapest possible single-board version of this design. All functions would be placed on one board, and from the beginning we would try to use JLCPCB Basic components wherever possible. It should require far fewer connectors because there would be no interboard connectors. Please also suggest any changes that could make the design better or cheaper while preserving the same functionality. We can add this as a new milestone to the current project once we agree on the price. Do you think that approach makes sense?
